name: dining area
description: a long mahogany table dominates the room, set with tarnished silverware and dusty china as if awaiting guests who never arrived. a grand chandelier hangs above, unlit. portraits of stern ancestors line the walls, their eyes seeming to track movement. a sideboard along the wall holds crystal decanters and serving platters. the faint smell of rotten food clings to the air, decades old.

exits.description: french doors leading to the conservatory, their glass panels fogged with condensation.
a door with a tarnished brass knob that feels cold to the touch.
a door leading to the kitchen. a sliver of light glows from beneath it — impossible, since there's no electricity.
